premise: Day 147 'Overstruck' stopped being a day's render — it became a seed-idea (the line printer's charset AS a tonal palette; the overstrike; the two-colour ribbon; the weave). This thread lets that idea grow as its own line of descent. The ROOT is the untouched daily-archive piece; branches descend from it, in pixels and in ink. The root is never rewritten — still 7ddf2b3d.

root.title: Overstruck
root.note: Canonical seed lives in selected-genomes.json (day 147), untouched. This thread descends from it; it does not rewrite it.

forkRule.line: Fidelity. A plot is a faithful EXPORT while it reproduces the root's checksum (output-only); it becomes a STUDY the moment a decision changes what is DRAWN. A screen COMPOSITION is a new piece with its OWN checksum — a branch, not the root.
forkRule.tell: When the work stops reproducing Overstruck and starts making decisions the root never made.

compositions.premise: New SCREEN compositions that evolve the overstrike — not plot-renditions, but the idea going where the navy-on-cream root didn't. Each is its own canonical seed (own checksum).

works.title: The Whale
works.idea: Overstruck in its two-colour typewriter/teletype RIBBON form. Using lpColorMode 'nested' (v3.20.0 — itself a gift back from the plotter studies), the nested rings alternate RED (the dash grounds + I-fields, the 'ruling') and BLACK (the dense # cores + solids, the 'writing') on cream. A NEW composition (own seed 271271), not a recolour of Day 147 — the first branch that goes where the navy root didn't: into colour.
works.lineage: root → compositions.overstruck-01. Keeps the root's dense character-tone (what makes it Overstruck) and adds the chromatic dimension the plotter studies discovered.

works.title: Second Pass
works.idea: The PLOT taught the engine a mark. Plotting 'The Whale' as two discrete pen passes (black writing + thin red ruling) made the solid-fill cores stop blending and ALTERNATE into a hard red/black CHECKER — a form no screen decision had proposed (see plotter-track.json findings 2026-11-08). This composition authors that accident: new lpColorMode 'checker' (v3.28.0) reddens only the solid-fill tier (▓/█) on odd cell parity, so the mass reads as a red/black checkerboard while the # overstrike texture around it stays black. Title = the typographic/plotter term for the overprint pass that IS the checker. noiseSeed 1909, renderSeed 20261108 (the date), picked from a seed sweep for the single cleanest focal mass.
works.lineage: root → compositions.overstruck-01 'The Whale' → compositions.overstruck-02 'Second Pass'. Same genome family (lineprinter, cream palette 8, red lpInk2) as 01; the one change is lpColorMode nested→checker. The idea now goes where neither the navy root NOR the first colour branch did: into a form the physical PLOT discovered and the engine learned to make.

certificate.c2: GREEN — Day 147 still 7ddf2b3d, overstruck-01 still 26cb3fbb (new lpColorMode value, opt-in; existing renders byte-identical)

plotter.premise: The pen takes Overstruck into ink — faithful renditions and studies that leave the root behind (per the fork rule). First physical plots on an AxiDraw.
plotter.summary: 6 studies (two-colour nested + weave swap/houndstooth/twill; tonal solid-black) + renditions (stroke/fill/signed). See plotter-track.json for the full branch.
